matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Controlled appeal cover, people/non-operative charge, Magistrates-to-Crown chronology, evidence, notice/deadline, rehearing and current-order map.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 10-14 pages; 300-500 words per narrative page or 10-22 sourced rows/events per table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF with stable links, bookmarks and controlled repeated headers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Missing certificate, disputed clock offset and pending extension/order retained through dated versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Health, custody and privileged strategy excluded from open overview; role variants enforce minimum access.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied record, generic appeal law, repeated chronology or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Magistrates' charge, plea and case-management forms, formal admissions, witness/exhibit index, applications/orders and certified hearing record.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-32 pages; forms at authentic density, transcript/notes 300-550 words/page and indexes 10-24 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed certified court scans and born-digital indexes/records; audio referenced if official source exists.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Corrected charge label, incomplete note and later-certified record retained with version history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Custody/health and personal details restricted; transferred record carries original access restrictions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No reconstructed hearing, duplicated forms, invented admission, repeated indexes or working note presented as certified.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Officer and healthcare statements, custody record, native audio/transcript, breath-device printouts/event logs, maintenance/calibration records and continuity schedule.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 26-38 pages; statements/transcript 300-600 words/page, logs 10-28 rows/page and device outputs at authentic sparse density.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed scans, native audio by hash, searchable transcript, original-format device printouts and native/born-digital logs; no simulated machine data.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Clock offset, error session, abbreviated health note and missing calibration certificate allowed as designed gaps.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Custody audio and health data minimised; native logs restricted to authorised parties/expert; served extracts preserve context.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated transcript, invented attempt, decorative device screens, duplicated logs or assumed calibration record.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: attempts reconcile by source without forced merge

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Magistrates' reasons, verdict/conviction record, sentence remarks, disqualification/costs decisions and perfected/service orders.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-22 pages; reasons 250-500 words/page and verdict/order forms at authentic sparse density.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital certified reasons and signed/sealed scanned orders; drafts visibly non-operative.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Later-perfected reasons or corrected order allowed with audit trail and no silent overwrite.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Public/restricted versions separated; health detail minimised in open reasons while material reasoning retained lawfully.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented reasons, duplicate orders, generic sentencing text or appeal interpretation inserted into historical record.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Signed appeal notice/grounds, deadline worksheet, service/address evidence, late explanation, extension application/response and stay/suspension applications/orders.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-22 pages; prescribed-style forms authentic, statements/applications 250-500 words/page and deadline/service tables 8-18 events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital forms and schedules with signed/scanned evidence; digital signature validation read-only and separate from filing receipt.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Address mismatch, corrected notice, late receipt and expired certificate permitted with full history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Defence advice/drafts privileged; filed forms role-available; addresses and health reasons minimised.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented receipt, hard-coded deadline conclusion, duplicate notices, generic law or automatic-stay statement.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Respondent notice/skeleton, Magistrates-record response, agreed/disputed chronology, service log and prosecution rehearing position.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-22 pages; skeleton 300-500 words/page and record/chronology/service tables 8-20 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital filed skeleton and schedules; signed correspondence where realistic; stable record IDs.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late record item, corrected chronology and amended expert response retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: No defence privilege; health/custody and personal data limited to necessary filed material; internal CPS advice excluded.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated Magistrates bundle, generic submissions, duplicate chronology or respondent claim shown as judicial finding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Crown Court case-management/directions, witness availability, expert issue/instruction pack, respiratory report/addendum, device material index and separate counsel/expert extracts.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-28 pages; directions/forms authentic, report 250-450 words/page and issue/material tables 8-18 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital directions and expert report with signed declaration; native device data referenced by hash; recipient extracts separately controlled.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unavailable witness, amended direction and narrowed expert opinion retained with transparent versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Expert gets minimum health/device material; counsel receives authorised record plus privilege; drafts and unrelated data restricted.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No full duplicate record, generic medical text, invented expert conclusion, repeated directions or overbroad recipient pack.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Certified Crown Court rehearing transcript/extracts, exhibit index, formal admissions, witness/expert evidence and attributed party submissions.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-42 pages; transcript 350-650 words/page and indexes/admissions 8-20 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Certified born-digital/scanned transcript and born-digital indexes; hearing audio referenced where authorised; no generated dialogue.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Inaudible marker, corrected speaker and later-certified replacement page retained.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Health/custody restrictions persist; privileged conferences excluded; expert and client extracts role-limited.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No reconstructed speech, duplicated Magistrates evidence, synthetic questions, repeated exhibits or submission presented as finding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Crown Court appeal decision/reasons, allowed/dismissed scope, conviction and sentence/disqualification/costs consequences, perfected orders, service and any further-deadline record.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 16-24 pages; reasons 300-550 words/page and orders/forms at authentic sparse density.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital certified reasons and signed/sealed orders; draft/oral/perfected versions visibly separated.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Reserved reasons, oral announcement and corrected consequential order retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Public/restricted decision variants separated; health detail minimised; privileged further advice excluded.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented reasons, duplicate orders, automatic consequences, generic appeal law or draft outcome shown as final.
